title: final-north-star-acceptance
rawUserRequest: WI-22 final-north-star-acceptance: conduct the final unified acceptance across installation, lifecycle, injection/Unknown, evidence, provider and adopter boundaries, Task Outcome, multilingual semantics, performance, code quality, stale assets, recovery, capability truth, and the North Star. Report only GO, CONDITIONAL_GO, or NO_GO with evidence-backed limitations.

rawRequestSource.reference: AI Cockpit comprehensive remediation instructions, WI-22; active user goal

declaredIntent.summary: Produce a source-bound final acceptance decision without turning local checks, fixtures, or policy claims into external-provider evidence.

outOfScope: Provider configuration, provider publication, or treating fixtures as real adopter/provider evidence.
The user-appended Work Item Intelligence Interface implementation.

sources.reason: Original remediation acceptance dimensions and decision rules.
Current source-bound capability and limitation facts.

scenarioCoverage.scenario: Every acceptance dimension has a source-bound evidence record or an explicit limitation.
scenarioCoverage.expected: A decision record without unsupported completion claims.
scenarioCoverage.verificationPlan: Focused evaluator regression and full governed verification.

scenarioCoverage.scenario: Missing provider/adopter evidence prevents GO rather than being inferred from local quality success.

riskAssessment.reason: A final acceptance report can incorrectly convert local or historical evidence into a broader readiness claim.

reasons: Initial Work Item skeleton defaults to Standard until scope is classified.

executionDecision.reason: Repository-local evidence can be evaluated and documented without external mutations.

preReviewWarnings: A GO decision requires real adopter and provider-bound evidence; do not infer either from fixtures or local checks.

checkpointPolicy.reason: Record at least one checkpoint before finishing to reduce mid-task drift.

acceptance: A structured final decision covers every named acceptance dimension with source-bound evidence or an explicit limitation.
The decision is limited to GO, CONDITIONAL_GO, or NO_GO and cannot report GO when required adopter/provider evidence is absent or stale.
Focused regressions reject missing dimensions and an unsupported GO decision.
Documentation distinguishes repository-local evidence from real adopter and provider evidence.
guidelines: Do not turn local test, fixture, policy, or historical archive evidence into a provider or adopter claim.
Every final-decision limitation must be machine-readable and visible to a human reader.
Do not modify provider configuration or historical archived Work Items.

intent.problem: The final remediation claim requires a current, unified, auditable decision instead of a collection of stale or differently scoped Work Item reports.
constraints: Do not claim external evidence that is not currently source-bound.
intent.rationale: A narrow evaluator makes the completion boundary legible and prevents local evidence from overstating external readiness.

restrictedWriteApproval.reason: Set only when a human explicitly approves restricted governance paths.
